title: JSON-safe task database mutation provider
minimumPromotionPolicy: Task database promotion requires JSON-only descriptors and patches, explicit owner/id mapping, stable errors, schema migration and rollback evidence, packaged row ownership, and no raw task, scheduler, cursor, or mutable row handles crossing into Node.
importedEvidence: P13-21 records the existing work_manager bridge, compat.tasks one-shot migration facade, and read-only NodeTimedTaskSnapshots evidence.
work_manager remains the only currently exposed scheduled-task module.
compat.tasks daily/weekly/update and IntentTask methods reject before bridge dispatch.
require("tasks"), global tasks, future task capabilities, raw TimedTask objects, database cursors, and mutable row handles remain unavailable.

requiredArchives.requiredEvidence: Live provider evidence for add, update, enable, disable, remove, list, and get over JSON descriptors and patches without raw task objects.
Owner and id mapping evidence proving Node ids, legacy TimedTask ids, packaged task ids, project identity, and package identity cannot alias across owners.
Schema version, downgrade, corruption recovery, unknown-version fail-closed, and rollback behavior for task descriptors and legacy row visibility.
Daily/weekly wall-clock scheduler evidence covering timezone and clock changes, reboot, Doze, exact-alarm permission, WorkManager/JobScheduler fallback, and quota diagnostics.
Packaged APK add/list/enable-disable/remove smoke proving packaged row ownership, disclosure, process death/relaunch behavior, task removal, and Safe downgrade policy.
